submission.implementation_notes: Naive recursive implementation using Pebble 0.4.4 with default compilation settings. The `.pebble` source is byte-identical to the 0.1.2 submission; only the compiler changed. Pebble 0.4.4 lowers `if` to a `case` on the built-in Bool returned by `lessThanInteger`, where 0.1.2 used `ifThenElse` with delayed branches. Casing on built-in values needs protocol version 11 (van Rossem), live on mainnet since 2026-07-18.
